contracts.name: R3.1 a write tool call to a frozen file exits 2 with a reason on stderr
R3.2 a write tool call to any path under .necro/ exits 2
R3.4 a tool call that touches no frozen file exits 0 and prints nothing
R3.5 a path is resolved to its real path and compared case-insensitively before the check
R3.6 a tool that is not known to be read-only is blocked when its input names a protected path
R3.11 a non-read-only tool call with a too long or NUL-containing input string is blocked
R1.1 canonicalJson sorts object keys recursively and writes no whitespace
R1.2 sha256 returns the SHA-256 digest as 64 lowercase hex characters
R1.3 the same value hashed in different key orders gives the same hash
R9.1 check on a frozen spec runs every frozen contract, prints each result by name, and writes a receipt with task null and every contract required
R9.2 check exits 0 and prints the receipt path when every contract passes, and exits 1 and still writes the receipt when any fails
R9.3 check on a spec that is not frozen exits 1 and says to freeze it first
R9.4 check does not change tasks.md
R2.9 freeze reads criteria from the task line and from the indented sub-lines under it, in both formats
R8.9 init writes .kiro/agents/necromancer.json with the steering resource, the three hooks, and deny rules for necro freeze and writes under .necro/; a second init leaves it unchanged and says so
R4.1 a str_replace on tasks.md is applied to the file on disk and gated when a task line changes from [ ] to [x]
R4.2 an fs_write to tasks.md is compared line by line with the file on disk and gated when a task line changes from [ ] to [x]
R4.3 marking a task done in a spec that is not frozen exits 2 and says the spec must be frozen first
R4.4 the gate runs the spec's frozen contracts itself, under the Node test runner, for every tick
R4.5 when a required contract fails the gate exits 2 and lists each failing required contract by name
R4.6 when all contracts pass the gate writes a receipt to .necro/receipts/<spec>/<receiptHash>.json and exits 0
R4.13 a write to a tasks.md that leaves more [x] task lines than the file on disk is gated, even when no line matches an earlier [ ] line
R4.19 task_update with status completed is gated like a tick written to tasks.md, with the same exit codes, messages and receipt
R4.20 a task_update to completed that names no task line requires every contract; a path outside the project is blocked
R8.1 init writes .kiro/hooks/necromancer.json with PreToolUse, PostToolUse and Stop hooks that call necro hook pre, post and stop, each with a timeout of 300 seconds
R8.2 init writes .kiro/steering/necromancer.md telling the agent that frozen contracts decide "done" and must not be edited
R8.3 if the hook and steering files already exist init leaves them unchanged and says so
R8.4 the PreToolUse hook init writes matches every tool, not a fixed list of write tools
R8.5 the PostToolUse hook init writes matches every write and shell tool named in Requirement 3
R8.6 init writes hook commands with the absolute, quoted path of the Node.js binary that ran init and of bin/necro.js
R8.7 init says Kiro runs hooks only in a trusted workspace and that after trusting it Kiro must be quit and reopened
R3.15 PostToolUse puts back the lock a shell command moved, byte for byte, before the 3.3 restore; a command that leaves the lock alone prints nothing; a lock a command created is removed
R2.1 freeze records the SHA-256 of requirements.md and of every contract file in .necro/lock.json
R2.2 freeze stores a copy of each frozen file at .necro/frozen/<sha256>
R2.3 freeze refuses when contracts/<spec>/ has no contract files and says at least one is needed
R2.4 freezing again replaces that spec's entry and keeps other specs' entries unchanged
R2.5 freeze runs the contracts once and records the name of every contract in the lock
R2.6 freeze refuses a contract whose path resolves outside the project root
R2.7 freeze records, for each task in tasks.md, the task id and the criteria its line names
R2.8 freeze records each task's full line text after the checkbox
R10.1 necro mcp answers initialize, ignores notifications, answers ping and tools/list, and exits 0 when stdin closes, writing only JSON-RPC messages to stdout and using no dependencies
R10.2 tools/list offers exactly necro_status, necro_check and necro_verify with input schemas, and each tool returns what Requirement 10 says
R10.3 no tool freezes, edits or ticks, and an unknown tool, an unfrozen spec and malformed JSON each get an error reply while the server keeps running
R10.4 a spec name or receipt path outside the project root is refused, also through ../ and a symbolic link
R10.5 power/ holds plugin.json with the Agent Plugins 1.0.0 fields, mcp.json that starts necro mcp, and a SKILL.md that teaches the workflow
R3.14 PreToolUse exits 2 for a shell command that runs necro freeze and says freezing is a person's step, and allows necro check, necro verify and a command that only mentions the word

R6.8 a receipt written before its spec was frozen again prints SUPERSEDED with the spec and the changed paths and exits 1, not MISMATCH, but a receipt whose files no longer match the lock is still a MISMATCH
R8.8 init writes a steering file saying a person freezes specs, the agent never runs necro freeze, and frozen specs are listed in .necro/lock.json
R5.1 a receipt records the spec, the git commit if available, and the hashes of the requirements, the contracts and the imported sources, with each result by name
R5.2 receiptHash is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the receipt without receiptHash and createdAt
R5.3 receipts made from identical inputs have the same receiptHash
R5.4 in a git repository a receipt records in uncommitted the sorted pinned paths that differ from the recorded commit, or [] when none do
R5.5 a receipt records task (the ticked task id and its line) and required (the sorted required contract names), and still every result
R4.14 a tick requires the contracts whose names start with a criterion the lock records for that task id
R4.15 every contract is required when the ticked task cannot be tied to the criteria the lock recorded
R4.16 every contract is required when the ticked line, the id or the unticked tasks cannot be trusted
R4.17 a contract file that holds a required contract and fails as a whole fails the tick
R4.18 only an unticked line on exactly one line with the frozen text counts as a frozen task that is still unticked
R4.7 a contract reported as skipped or todo counts as failing
R4.8 a frozen spec whose contract files contain zero contracts is refused, not passed
R4.9 a contract file whose hash differs from the lock when it is run makes every contract in that file fail
R4.10 a contract name recorded in the lock that is missing from a run counts as failing
R4.11 contract names are kept exactly as reported, and only the file's own path is a file load failure
R4.12 results come from the Node test runner's events, never from text the code under test prints, and names are matched per file
R3.3 after a shell command, a frozen file whose SHA-256 changed is restored and named on stderr
R3.7 a shell command that ticks a task is checked, and undone with the failing names on stderr if a contract fails
R3.8 before each shell call the current tasks.md of every frozen spec is recorded, replacing any earlier record
R3.9 when the recorded state changed during the command, every [x] task line counts as newly ticked
R3.10 a write to tasks.md is recorded by PostToolUse from the file on disk, not before the write
R3.12 every Kiro shell tool gets the execute_bash treatment
R3.13 fs_append and delete_file on tasks.md are writes to tasks.md for the done gate
R7.1 the Stop handler prints, for each frozen spec, the tasks marked done, the receipts, and the names of the contracts failing now

R6.9 necro verify on an example's receipt gives the same output and exit code from the repository root, the example folder and an unrelated folder, and a receipt outside any project is checked in the current folder
R6.10 necro verify prints Project: and the absolute path of the project first when its root is not the current folder, and no such line from the root itself
R6.1 verify prints CONFIRMED and the receipt hash and exits 0 when every hashed file matches and the contracts give the same results
R6.2 verify prints MISMATCH with each differing path and exits 1 when a hashed file differs
R6.3 verify prints MISMATCH with each differing contract name and exits 1 when a contract result differs
R6.4 verify first recomputes the receiptHash and prints MISMATCH saying the receipt was altered when it differs
R6.5 verify prints MISMATCH and exits 1 for a receipt that pins no requirements file or no contracts
R6.6 when the spec is frozen in the local lock verify also checks the receipt's requirements and contract hashes against it
R6.7 when a lock exists verify requires the receipt to equal the lock exactly and runs the lock's contracts, so a receipt that leaves out a failing contract is a MISMATCH
